name: Prototype-to-PR prompt
summary: A reusable prompt that helps a designer or product partner turn a working prototype into implementation-ready notes and starter code suggestions.
handoffRemoved: Reduces the wait between design review and engineering kickoff by turning a prototype into a more implementation-ready handoff.

setup.content: Review this prototype and produce: 1. the intended user outcome, 2. the edge cases, 3. a starter implementation outline, 4. open feasibility questions, and 5. a first-pass PR checklist.

limitations: It does not replace technical design review or guarantee the right architecture.
